# **FAMEWOVEN Frontend Architecture, Design System, and Multi-Page Specification**

## **Strategic Rebrand Architecture and Competitive Synthesis**

The corporate transformation of PromptForge LLC (promptforgestudio.net) into FAMEWOVEN (famewoven.com) represents a structural evolution from a single-channel X (Twitter) creator marketing vendor into a full-stack AI Influencer and Creative Agency1. In its legacy iteration, PromptForge operated as a tactical execution layer for AI, SaaS, and developer-tool launches on X, coordinating 14 distinct campaign formats ranging from single sponsored posts to 100+ creator waves2. While that operational model proved highly effective for short-term launch velocity—securing clients such as HeyGen, Higgsfield, BytePlus, and Omneky2—it remained constrained by third-party creator availability, human talent scheduling friction, and single-platform dependency2.  
The creator economy is undergoing a structural bifurcation between human creator brokerage and synthetic brand-owned intellectual property4. Industry financial benchmarks demonstrate that an average sponsored post with a traditional human influencer commands \$78,777, whereas an AI influencer post averages \$1,694—a 97.8% unit-cost reduction accompanied by absolute narrative control, zero public-relations volatility, and instantaneous global localization4. Pioneers in the virtual human space, such as The Clueless (creators of Aitana López, generating €10,000 per month) and Dapper Labs (Lil Miquela, generating \$2 million to \$10 million annually), prove that virtual personas are commercially viable assets when directed with human editorial taste7. However, standalone AI character studios frequently fail to deliver measurable pipeline because they lack the multi-creator distribution mechanics required to dominate algorithmic feeds10.  
FAMEWOVEN bridges this divide by synthesizing two complementary engines under the brand proposition *"Influence, woven."* and *"Virtual talent. Human direction."*1. The first engine comprises FAMEWOVEN’s four core creative production pillars: **AI Influencer Creation**, **Campaign Production**, **Virtual Talent Direction**, and **Ongoing Content**1. The second engine preserves and elevates PromptForge’s 14 campaign amplification and creator orchestration formats into a cross-platform distribution matrix spanning X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn2. Corporate clients can either commission a proprietary virtual brand ambassador built from scratch, cast an existing persona from the FAMEWOVEN talent roster, or deploy a coordinated wave of 1 to 100+ virtual and human creators engineered for guaranteed reach and conversion1.  
![][image1]  
To achieve a frontend execution that surpasses contemporary agency benchmarks, the FAMEWOVEN web architecture synthesizes specific structural, functional, and conversion patterns from five reference platforms alongside the legacy PromptForge codebase2. From ChamakMedia (chamakmedia.com), the specification extracts and upgrades the interactive **Live Sourcing Simulator** (where prospects click creator cards to compute combined reach and zero-risk escrow terms) and the **5-Stage End-to-End Flight Console** (simulating the campaign lifecycle from brief to attribution)11. From Brenton Way (brentonway.com), the design adopts the persistent **Top Utility Promo Banner**, the above-the-fold **Interactive Audit Lead Magnet Bar**, value-anchored consultation calls to action, and the three-stage growth framework (Attract / Convert / Retain, adapted into FAMEWOVEN’s Character / Campaign / Continuity)1. From Quoleady (quoleady.com), the system incorporates the **Header Mega-Menu Promo Card**, the explicit **8-Step Workflow Grid**, and metric-backed client case study cards13. From Mayple (mayple.com), the interface integrates quantitative filter tabs with live talent counts and a transparent **Side-by-Side Agency Comparison Matrix**15. Finally, from The Clueless (theclueless.ai) and AI Influencer Agency workflows, the site adopts series-coded virtual persona galleries (01-Influencers, 02-Women, 03-Men, 05-Underground), the five Digital Identity service archetypes, and the three-layer operational data model (Identity Layer, Campaign Layer, and Asset Layer)8.

## **Global Design System, Brand Tokens, and Tailwind Configuration**

The visual identity of FAMEWOVEN is governed by the directive *"A quiet base. A sharp signal. Ink and chalk lead. Weft brings emphasis. Plum lives in imagery."*1. Unlike generic AI agencies that rely on neon purple-to-cyan gradients and cluttered dark-mode glassmorphism, FAMEWOVEN employs a high-fashion editorial aesthetic anchored in deep carbon-black (INK), warm architectural paper (CHALK), and razor-sharp chartreuse signal accents (WEFT), with deep aubergine (PLUM) reserved strictly for portrait lighting, atmospheric vignette underlays, and image containers1.  
![][image2]

### **Color Token Architecture and Surface Rules**

Every DOM element across the multi-page architecture must strictly reference the five canonical brand tokens and their derived opacity states1. Arbitrary Tailwind grays or off-brand accent hues are prohibited so that the alternating rhythm between dark INK sections and light CHALK editorial spreads remains disciplined1.

### **Typography Scale, Font Pairings, and Logo Geometry Rules**

The typographic system enforces strict separation of duties across three Google Font families: **Outfit** (Medium 500\) for the lowercase famewoven brand wordmark, **Space Grotesk** (Bold 700 for headlines, Medium 500 for sub-headers, and Regular 400 for body copy), and **IBM Plex Mono** (Regular 400, Medium 500, and Bold 700\) for technical captions, section indices, and metadata tags1. In accordance with 03/LOGO USE in the Brand Identity specification, the logo lockup must maintain a clear-space perimeter equal to at least half the height of the F weave symbol (24px minimum clear space when the symbol renders at 48px)1. The standalone geometric F symbol must never render smaller than 48px × 48px (12mm), and the complete famewoven wordmark must never render narrower than 160px (35mm), utilizing solid \#F1EFE8 (Chalk) or \#D1F34A (Weft) on dark \#111311 / \#291A27 surfaces, or solid \#111311 (Ink) on \#F1EFE8 (Chalk) surfaces1.

## **Creative Preloader and Global GSAP Animation Architecture (Strict Zero-3D-Hover Policy)**

In strict compliance with the frontend engineering mandate, **all 3D hover effects (rotateX, rotateY, perspective, WebGL 3D card tilts, and Three.js shaders) are prohibited across the entire codebase**. Instead, the platform achieves tactile, editorial sophistication through **2D geometric weave mechanics, SVG path drawing, clip-path curtain reveals, magnetic vector displacement, and precision GSAP ScrollTrigger choreography** inspired by the brand principle *"The weave is the craft. Use the weave as a material and a composition."*1.

### **Signature Creative Loading Screen: "The Digital Loom" (\#preloader)**

The loading screen transforms the concept of weaving virtual influence into a 2.4-second choreography executed via SVG and GSAP before revealing the Hero viewport1. At initialization, a fixed full-viewport overlay (fixed inset-0 z-\[9999\] bg-ink flex flex-col justify-between p-6 lg:p-12 overflow-hidden) is segmented into six vertical **Warp Columns** (.loom-col, each w-1/6 h-full bg-ink border-r border-ash/15 relative) overlaid by a central SVG stage and a bottom telemetry bar. During Phase 1 (0.0s to 1.1s), vertical **Warp Lines** (stroke="\#F1EFE8" and \#A7A59B) animate from top to bottom (strokeDashoffset: 48 \-\> 0, duration: 0.55s, stagger: 0.08s, ease: "power3.inOut"), immediately intersected by horizontal **Weft Signal Threads** (stroke="\#D1F34A", stroke-width="6") shooting left-to-right across center stage to construct the geometric **FAMEWOVEN F Symbol** (64px × 64px, exceeding the 48px minimum rule)1.  
During Phase 2 (0.9s to 1.7s), the lowercase wordmark famewoven (font-wordmark font-medium text-3xl lg:text-4xl text-chalk tracking-tight min-w-\[160px\]) slides upward out of an overflow mask (y: "0%", duration: 0.6s, ease: "expo.out") alongside the subtitle Influence, woven.1. Concurrently, in the bottom-right corner, an IBM Plex Mono counter (\#preloader-counter) increments from 000% to 100% while the top-right status string (\#preloader-status) cycles through three operational states: INITIALIZING WEAVE ENGINE... (0–35%), LOCKING VISUAL REFERENCE SYSTEM... (36–75%), and INFLUENCE, WOVEN // READY (76–100%)1. During Phase 3 (1.7s to 2.4s), rather than executing a conventional opacity fade, the six vertical .loom-col panels part like a mechanical loom shed: odd columns (1, 3, 5\) slide upward (yPercent: \-100) while even columns (2, 4, 6\) slide downward (yPercent: 100, duration: 0.75s, stagger: 0.04s, ease: "expo.inOut"), unveiling the Hero section underneath. Storing sessionStorage.setItem('fw\_loaded', 'true') ensures that subsequent internal page navigation runs a streamlined 0.55s six-column weave wipe rather than repeating the full 2.4-second sequence.

| Preloader & Global Animation Module | Target DOM Selector | Timing & Easing Parameters | 2D GSAP / CSS Mechanism (Zero 3D Tilt) | Brand & UX Function |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Preloader Phase 1: Thread Interlace** | \#loom-logo-svg .warp-line, .weft-line | 0.0s – 1.1s, power3.inOut & power4.out | Animates SVG strokeDashoffset to 0, locking the \#F1EFE8 vertical warp and \#D1F34A horizontal weft bars into the F mark1. | Establishes *"The weave is the craft"* immediately upon arrival1. |
| **Preloader Phase 2: Wordmark & Telemetry** | \#loom-wordmark, \#preloader-counter | 0.9s – 1.7s, expo.out & power2.inOut | Reveals famewoven (Outfit Medium) from translateY(100%) while incrementing the IBM Plex Mono counter from 000% to 100%1. | Reinforces technical precision and studio authority1. |
| **Preloader Phase 3: Loom Shed Split** | .loom-col (6 vertical columns) | 1.7s – 2.4s, stagger: 0.04s, expo.inOut | Odd columns translate to yPercent: \-100; even columns translate to yPercent: 100\. | Creates a signature architectural curtain reveal into the Hero viewport1. |
| **Weave Corner Brackets** | .fw-card, Service, Bento & Persona Cards | 0.25s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1\) | Four 10px × 10px 2px solid \#D1F34A corner brackets transition from opacity: 0; scale(0.8) to opacity: 1; scale(1) on hover or selection. | Frames cards like a medium-format camera viewfinder without 3D tilt1. |

Defined light. Natural texture."*1. |

### **Section 00: Top Utility Signal Bar (\#signal-bar) and Section 01: Sticky Header (\#nav)**

Section 00 adapts Brenton Way’s top-of-page free audit banner (🔥 Get for free: 360° ai marketing audit) and ChamakMedia’s founding cohort pilot notification into a high-contrast signal bar positioned at the very top of the DOM (w-full bg-weft text-ink py-2 px-4 border-b border-ink/15 z-50 relative)1. ## **Production Frontend Code Architecture (HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla JS, and GSAP)**

The following production code blocks provide the complete CSS3 custom rules (styles.css), the HTML5 structural implementation (index.html core modules), and the Vanilla JavaScript \+ GSAP orchestration engine (script.js) powering the Digital Loom Preloader, the 2D Warp-Weft Canvas, the 18-Service Filter Grid, the Live Casting Simulator, the 5-Stage Flight Console, and the Campaign Scale Slider1.

### **1\. Custom Stylesheet (styles.css)**

CSS  
:root {  
  \--fw-ink: \#111311;  
  \--fw-ink-elevated: \#181B18;  
  \--fw-chalk: \#F1EFE8;  
  \--fw-weft: \#D1F34A;  
  \--fw-plum: \#291A27;  
  \--fw-ash: \#A7A59B;  
  \--fw-border: rgba(167, 165, 155, 0.18);  
}

html {  
  background-color: var(--fw-ink);  
  color: var(--fw-chalk);  
  font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;  
  scroll-behavior: smooth;  
}

::selection {  
  background-color: var(--fw-weft);  
  color: var(--fw-ink);  
}

/\* Exposed Editorial Weave Grid Background \*/  
.weave-bg-grid {  
  background-size: 64px 64px;  
  background-image:  
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(167, 165, 155, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),  
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(167, 165, 155, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);  
}

/\* 2D Weave Corner Brackets (Strict Zero-3D-Hover Policy) \*/  
.fw-card {  
  position: relative;  
  transition: border-color 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease;  
}

.fw-card::before,  
.fw-card::after {  
  content: '';  
  position: absolute;  
  width: 10px;  
  height: 10px;  
  border-color: var(--fw-weft);  
  opacity: 0;  
  transform: scale(0.8);  
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);  
  pointer-events: none;  
  z-index: 10;  
}

.fw-card::before {  
  top: \-1px;  
  left: \-1px;  
  border-top: 2px solid var(--fw-weft);  
  border-left: 2px solid var(--fw-weft);  
}

.fw-card::after {  
  bottom: \-1px;  
  right: \-1px;  
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--fw-weft);  
  border-right: 2px solid var(--fw-weft);  
}

.fw-card:hover::before,  
.fw-card:hover::after,  
.fw-card.is-selected::before,  
.fw-card.is-selected::after {  
  opacity: 1;  
  transform: scale(1);  
}

/\* Custom Range Slider for Campaign Scale Section \*/  
input\[type="range"\].fw-slider {  
  \-webkit-appearance: none;  
  appearance: none;  
  width: 100%;  
  height: 6px;  
  background: rgba(167, 165, 155, 0.2);  
  outline: none;  
}

input\[type="range"\].fw-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {  
  \-webkit-appearance: none;  
  appearance: none;  
  width: 22px;  
  height: 22px;  
  background: var(--fw-weft);  
  border: 2px solid var(--fw-ink);  
  cursor: pointer;  
}

/\* Reduced Motion Accessibility Compliance \*/  
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {  
  \*, ::before, ::after {  
    animation-duration: 0.01ms \!important;  
    animation-iteration-count: 1 \!important;  
    transition-duration: 0.01ms \!important;  
    scroll-behavior: auto \!important;  
  }  
}

/\* 1\. Digital Loom Preloader Choreography \*/  
function initLoomPreloader() {  
  const preloader \= document.getElementById('preloader');  
  if (\!preloader) return;

  const counterObj \= { val: 0 };  
  const counterEl \= document.getElementById('preloader-counter');  
  const statusEl \= document.getElementById('preloader-status');

  const tl \= gsap.timeline({  
    onComplete: () \=\> {  
      preloader.style.display \= 'none';  
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();  
    }  
  });

  tl.to('.warp-line', {  
    strokeDashoffset: 0,  
    duration: 0.55,  
    stagger: 0.08,  
    ease: 'power3.inOut'  
  })  
  .to('.weft-line', {  
    strokeDashoffset: 0,  
    duration: 0.45,  
    stagger: 0.1,  
    ease: 'power4.out'  
  }, '-=0.25')  
  .to('.weave-node', { opacity: 1, duration: 0.2 }, '-=0.1')  
  .to('\#loom-wordmark', { y: '0%', duration: 0.6, ease: 'expo.out' }, '-=0.3')  
  .to('\#loom-sub', { opacity: 1, duration: 0.4 }, '-=0.3')  
  .to(counterObj, {  
    val: 100,  
    duration: 1.4,  
    ease: 'power2.inOut',  
    onUpdate: () \=\> {  
      const v \= Math.round(counterObj.val);  
      if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent \= String(v).padStart(3, '0') \+ '%';  
      if (statusEl) {  
        if (v \> 75) statusEl.textContent \= 'INFLUENCE, WOVEN // READY';  
        else if (v \> 35) statusEl.textContent \= 'LOCKING VISUAL REFERENCE SYSTEM...';  
      }  
    }  
  }, 0)  
  .to(\['\#loom-logo-svg', '\#loom-wordmark', '\#loom-sub', '.preloader-meta'\], {  
    opacity: 0,  
    y: \-16,  
    duration: 0.3,  
    ease: 'power2.in'  
  })  
  .to('.loom-col', {  
    yPercent: (i) \=\> (i % 2 \=== 0 ? \-100 : 100),  
    duration: 0.75,  
    stagger: 0.04,  
    ease: 'expo.inOut'  
  }, '-=0.1');  
}

/\* 2\. Interactive 2D Warp-Weft Hero Canvas \*/  
function initWeaveCanvas() {  
  const canvas \= document.getElementById('weave-canvas');  
  if (\!canvas) return;  
  const ctx \= canvas.getContext('2d');  
  let width, height;  
  const spacing \= 64;  
  let pulses \= \[\];

  function resize() {  
    width \= canvas.width \= canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;  
    height \= canvas.height \= canvas.parentElement.offsetHeight;  
  }  
  resize();  
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  for (let i \= 0; i \< 8; i++) {  
    pulses.push({  
      horizontal: i % 2 \=== 0,  
      lineIndex: Math.floor(Math.random() \* 16) \+ 1,  
      pos: Math.random() \* 1000,  
      speed: 1.2 \+ Math.random() \* 1.5  
    });  
  }

  function render() {  
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);  
    ctx.strokeStyle \= 'rgba(167, 165, 155, 0.07)';  
    ctx.lineWidth \= 1;

    for (let x \= spacing; x \< width; x \+= spacing) {  
      ctx.beginPath();  
      ctx.moveTo(x, 0);  
      ctx.lineTo(x, height);  
      ctx.stroke();  
    }  
    for (let y \= spacing; y \< height; y \+= spacing) {  
      ctx.beginPath();  
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);  
      ctx.lineTo(width, y);  
      ctx.stroke();  
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle \= '\#D1F34A';  
    ctx.lineWidth \= 1.5;  
    pulses.forEach((p) \=\> {  
      p.pos \+= p.speed;  
      ctx.beginPath();  
      if (p.horizontal) {  
        const y \= (p.lineIndex \* spacing) % height;  
        if (p.pos \> width) p.pos \= \-80;  
        ctx.moveTo(p.pos, y);  
        ctx.lineTo(p.pos \+ 56, y);  
      } else {  
        const x \= (p.lineIndex \* spacing) % width;  
        if (p.pos \> height) p.pos \= \-80;  
        ctx.moveTo(x, p.pos);  
        ctx.lineTo(x, p.pos \+ 56);  
      }  
      ctx.stroke();  
    });  
    requestAnimationFrame(render);  
  }  
  render();  
}

/\* 3\. Dynamic 18-Service Grid & Form Pre-Selection \*/  
function initServicesGrid() {  
  const grid \= document.getElementById('services-grid');  
  const select \= document.getElementById('f-type');  
  const chips \= document.querySelectorAll('\[data-filter\]');

  if (select) {  
    FAMEWOVEN\_SERVICES.forEach((s) \=\> {  
      const opt \= document.createElement('option');  
      opt.value \= s.title;  
      opt.textContent \= \`\${s.code} — \${s.title}\`;  
      select.appendChild(opt);  
    });  
  }

  function renderServices(filter \= 'all') {  
    if (\!grid) return;  
    const items \= filter \=== 'all' ? FAMEWOVEN\_SERVICES : FAMEWOVEN\_SERVICES.filter((s) \=\> s.cat \=== filter);  
    grid.innerHTML \= items.map((s) \=\> \`  
      \<article class="fw-card bg-ink border border-ash/20 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer hover:border-weft/60" data-service="\${s.title}"\>  
        \<div\>  
          \<div class="flex justify-between items-center font-mono text-\[11px\] text-ash mb-4"\>  
            \<span class="text-weft"\>\${s.code} // \${s.cat.toUpperCase()}\</span\>  
            \<span\>FAMEWOVEN\</span\>  
          \</div\>  
          \<h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-chalk mb-2"\>\${s.title}\</h3\>  
          \<p class="text-sm text-ash leading-relaxed"\>\${s.desc}\</p\>  
        \</div\>  
        \<div class="pt-6 mt-6 border-t border-ash/15 flex justify-between items-center font-mono text-xs text-chalk"\>  
          \<span\>Select capability\</span\>  
          \<span class="text-weft"\>Start brief ↗\</span\>  
        \</div\>  
      \</article\>  
    \`).join('');

    grid.querySelectorAll('\[data-service\]').forEach((card) \=\> {  
      card.addEventListener('click', () \=\> {  
        if (select) select.value \= card.dataset.service;  
        document.getElementById('contact')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });  
      });  
    });  
  }

  renderServices('all');  
  chips.forEach((chip) \=\> {  
    chip.addEventListener('click', () \=\> {  
      chips.forEach((c) \=\> c.classList.remove('bg-weft', 'text-ink'));  
      chip.classList.add('bg-weft', 'text-ink');  
      renderServices(chip.dataset.filter);  
    });  
  });  
}

/\* 4\. Live Virtual Casting & Creator Sourcing Simulator \*/  
function initCastingSimulator() {  
  const container \= document.getElementById('simulator-cards');  
  const countEl \= document.getElementById('sim-count');  
  const reachEl \= document.getElementById('sim-reach');  
  const costEl \= document.getElementById('sim-cost');  
  if (\!container) return;

  function updateSimulatorUI() {  
    const active \= SIMULATOR\_PROFILES.filter((p) \=\> p.selected);  
    const totalReach \= active.reduce((acc, p) \=\> acc \+ p.reachNum, 0);  
    const totalCost \= active.reduce((acc, p) \=\> acc \+ p.rate, 0);

    if (countEl) countEl.textContent \= active.length;  
    if (reachEl) reachEl.textContent \= (totalReach / 1000).toFixed(0) \+ 'K+';  
    if (costEl) costEl.textContent \= '\$' \+ totalCost.toLocaleString();

    container.innerHTML \= SIMULATOR\_PROFILES.map((p) \=\> \`  
      \<div class="fw-card p-4 border \${p.selected ? 'border-weft bg-weft/10 is-selected' : 'border-ash/20 bg-ink-elevated'} cursor-pointer" data-sim-id="\${p.id}"\>  
        \<div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2"\>  
          \<div\>  
            \<h4 class="font-bold text-chalk text-base"\>\${p.name}\</h4\>  
            \<span class="font-mono text-\[11px\] text-ash"\>\${p.handle}\</span\>  
          \</div\>  
          \<span class="font-mono text-\[10px\] px-2 py-0.5 \${p.selected ? 'bg-weft text-ink font-bold' : 'bg-plum text-chalk'}"\>\${p.type}\</span\>  
        \</div\>  
        \<p class="text-xs text-ash mb-3"\>\${p.niche}\</p\>  
        \<div class="flex justify-between items-center pt-3 border-t border-ash/15 font-mono text-xs"\>  
          \<span class="text-chalk"\>\${p.reachLabel}\</span\>  
          \<span class="text-weft"\>\${p.er}\</span\>  
          \<span class="text-chalk font-bold"\>\$\${p.rate.toLocaleString()}\</span\>  
        \</div\>  
      \</div\>  
    \`).join('');

    container.querySelectorAll('\[data-sim-id\]').forEach((el) \=\> {  
      el.addEventListener('click', () \=\> {  
        const profile \= SIMULATOR\_PROFILES.find((item) \=\> item.id \=== el.dataset.simId);  
        if (profile) {  
          profile.selected \= \!profile.selected;  
          updateSimulatorUI();  
        }  
      });  
    });  
  }  
  updateSimulatorUI();  
}

/\* 5\. End-to-End 5-Stage Flight Console \*/  
function initFlightConsole() {  
  let idx \= 0;  
  const stageEl \= document.getElementById('flight-stage-indicator');  
  const titleEl \= document.getElementById('flight-title');  
  const goalEl \= document.getElementById('flight-goal');  
  const viewsEl \= document.getElementById('flight-views');  
  const channelsEl \= document.getElementById('flight-channels');  
  const delivEl \= document.getElementById('flight-deliverable');  
  const nextBtn \= document.getElementById('flight-next-btn');

  function renderStage(i) {  
    const s \= FLIGHT\_STAGES\[i\];  
    if (\!s \|\| \!titleEl) return;  
    stageEl.textContent \= \`STAGE \${s.stage}\`;  
    titleEl.textContent \= s.title;  
    goalEl.textContent \= s.goal;  
    viewsEl.textContent \= s.views;  
    channelsEl.textContent \= s.channels;  
    delivEl.textContent \= s.deliverable;  
  }

  if (nextBtn) {  
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () \=\> {  
      idx \= (idx \+ 1) % FLIGHT\_STAGES.length;  
      renderStage(idx);  
    });  
  }  
  renderStage(0);  
}

/\* 6\. Interactive Campaign Scale Slider (1 to 100+ Creators/Assets) \*/  
function initScaleSlider() {  
  const slider \= document.getElementById('scale-range');  
  const outEl \= document.getElementById('scale-out');  
  const tierEl \= document.getElementById('scale-tier');  
  const typeEl \= document.getElementById('scale-type');  
  const descEl \= document.getElementById('scale-type-desc');  
  if (\!slider) return;

  function updateScale() {  
    const val \= parseInt(slider.value, 10);  
    if (outEl) outEl.textContent \= val \> 100 ? '100+' : String(val);  
    const activeTier \= SCALE\_TIERS.find((t) \=\> val \<= t.max) \|\| SCALE\_TIERS\[SCALE\_TIERS.length \- 1\];  
    if (tierEl) tierEl.textContent \= activeTier.tier;  
    if (typeEl) typeEl.textContent \= activeTier.title;  
    if (descEl) descEl.textContent \= activeTier.desc;  
  }

  slider.addEventListener('input', updateScale);  
  updateScale();  
}

## **Implementation Verification Matrix and Engineering Hand-Off**

To guarantee an error-free deployment across all six pages (index.html, talent.html, services.html, campaigns.html, how-it-works.html, and contact.html), the frontend build must pass six verification gates prior to production release1. The table below details each verification gate, the target codebase scope, and the required pass criteria.

| Verification Gate | Target Files & Selectors | Technical Audit & Acceptance Criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **01\. Brand Token Purity** | styles.css, tailwind.config, all .html files | Zero legacy PromptForge orange/ember styles (\#0A0A0B) remain; all surfaces strictly use \#111311 (INK), \#F1EFE8 (CHALK), \#D1F34A (WEFT), \#291A27 (PLUM), and \#A7A59B (ASH)1. |
| **02\. Logo & Type Hierarchy** | \#nav, \#preloader, \#footer, h1–h4 | The lowercase famewoven wordmark (Outfit Medium 500\) never renders below 160px width; the F symbol never renders below 48px height with 0.5x clear space; headlines use Space Grotesk Bold (700) and metadata uses IBM Plex Mono1. |
| **03\. Zero-3D-Hover Policy** | styles.css, script.js, .fw-card | Zero instances of perspective, rotateX, rotateY, or transform-style: preserve-3d exist; all interactive states execute via 2D \#D1F34A corner brackets, clip-path shutters, and horizontal flex expansion. |
| **04\. Synthetic Media Labeling** | .portrait-frame, /talent.html, /campaigns.html | Every AI persona card and campaign frame displays the IBM Plex Mono metadata badge AI-GENERATED CHARACTER / CONCEPT in compliance with 07/PORTRAIT DIRECTION and 12/VOICE1. |
| **05\. Simulator-to-Brief Binding** | \#services-grid, \#sim-book-btn, \#contact-form | Clicking any of the 18 services (FW-01 to PF-14), any persona card, or the Live Casting Simulator booking button automatically populates \#f-type in \#contact-form and smooth-scrolls to \#contact2. |
| **06\. Schema & SEO Continuity** | \<head\> JSON-LD across all pages | \<script type="application/ld+json"\> declares FAMEWOVEN (formerly PromptForge LLC) with canonical URL https\://famewoven.com/ and verified endpoints (hello@famewoven.com, support@promptforgestudio.net, \+1-307-445-3324)1. |
